lines.text: Many learners say: I have an arbeit after school.
Better: I have a part-time job after school.
Arbeit is not an English word.
Part-time job! I have a part-time job after school.

data.wrong: I have an arbeit after school.
data.right: I have a part-time job after school.
data.why: Arbeit is not an English word.
